title: super-net: trustworthy image segmentation via uncertainty propagation in encoder-decoder networks
core_idea: Introduce a Bayesian framework called reliability super-net that propagates the posterior mean and covariance through nonlinear encoder-decoder layers using Taylor series approximations to produce both a segmented image and a pixel-wise uncertainty map without relying on Monte Carlo sampling.
tldr: A Bayesian encoder-decoder method that analytically propagates uncertainty via Taylor series to output segmentation and per-pixel confidence maps, enabling self-assessment of reliability under noisy and adversarial inputs.
